title: Swimming and coordination
learning_outcomes: Explain buoyancy in the context of swimming and coordination.
Compare and distinguish stroke coordination in the context of swimming and coordination.
Apply water hazards in the context of swimming and coordination.
Evaluate and justify decisions about supervised practice in the context of swimming and coordination.

lessons.title: Buoyancy
lessons.outcome: Explain buoyancy in the context of swimming and coordination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving buoyancy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to dry-land water safety plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain buoyancy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of buoyancy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Stroke coordination
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish stroke coordination in the context of swimming and coordination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stroke coordination; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to dry-land water safety plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain stroke coordination from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stroke coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Water hazards
lessons.outcome: Apply water hazards in the context of swimming and coordination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving water hazards; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to dry-land water safety plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain water hazards from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of water hazards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Supervised practice
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about supervised practice in the context of swimming and coordination.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving supervised practice; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to dry-land water safety plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain supervised practice from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of supervised practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of buoyancy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of stroke coordination; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of water hazards; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of supervised practice; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
